scope: A-board bounded RAM handoff, PWM0 G0/G1, 2MHz, unrouted invalid configs then MIO21/D11 valid8/16 pulse recovery
observation: IRQ71 count/group errors reassert after W1C while invalid configuration persists. Masking event delivery before acknowledgement bounds entry to1 per fault. Repairing configuration, START, then W1C clears status; normal8/16 pulse output recovers. Count error also sets configuration-loaded flag; group-conflict case does not.
limits: Invalid-output waveform is not physically routed or qualified
No evidence for exact fault reassertion latency or shadow-write-only recovery
QEMU conservatively retains active error until corrected START, reasserts at MMIO boundaries
Multi-channel atomic rejection remains an explicit model assumption, not a silicon conclusion
Other channels, simultaneous fault combinations and production control-core handoff unqualified
